Q14.question: According to the passage, what is the biggest obstacle to developing intercultural awareness?

options.A: Learning too many foreign languages at the same time
options.B: Working in teams with people from different countries
options.C: Believing that one's own cultural habits are universal
options.D: Not having enough opportunities to travel abroad

Q15.question: The passage suggests that intercultural awareness develops naturally as soon as people work in international teams.

Q16.question: The passage implies that understanding other cultures also requires people to reflect on their own cultural assumptions.

Q17.question: Drag the correct word into the corresponding gap (completed text).
Q17.answer: Intercultural awareness is an essential skill in today's globalized world. It involves understanding how cultural backgrounds shape communication and behavior, and it helps people avoid misunderstandings in international settings. Developing this awareness requires effort, curiosity, and a willingness to question one's own assumptions, making it an important part of becoming an effective global citizen.

matching_definitions.definition: A formal academic event in which a researcher presents and justifies their work before a committee.
A new business created to develop an innovative idea, product, or service.
A new direction or practice that becomes increasingly common in teaching and learning.
The ability to understand and respect cultural differences in communication, values, and behaviour.
A willingness to consider new ideas, perspectives, or ways of thinking without prejudice.

reorder_paragraph.instruction: Reorder the scrambled sentences to form a coherent paragraph.
correct_order: Brian Chesky co-founded Airbnb in 2008 after renting out air mattresses in his apartment to earn some extra money.
At first, many investors did not believe in the idea, so the founders had to improve their prototype and business plan several times.
The idea challenged traditional hotels and changed the way people travel and find accommodation.
His open-mindedness and ability to learn from different cultures helped the company grow quickly in the global market.
Today, Airbnb is used around the world, and Chesky's story is often shared in universities as an example of creativity and resilience.
